𝟭𝟱 𝗗𝗮𝘆𝘀. 𝟭𝟱 𝗙𝗮𝗰𝘂𝗹𝘁𝗶𝗲𝘀. 𝗔 𝘄𝗵𝗼𝗹𝗲 𝗻𝗲𝘄 𝗹𝗲𝗮𝗿𝗻𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝗲𝘅𝗽𝗲𝗿𝗶𝗲𝗻𝗰𝗲. ✨

My 15-day OC Training journey has just begun, and the first three days have already brought three different experiences.

𝗗𝗮𝘆 𝟭 | 𝗖𝗔 𝗕𝗵𝗮𝗿𝗮𝘁 𝗕𝗵𝘂𝘀𝗵𝗮𝗻
Day 1 began with introductions .

Sounds simple, right? But introducing yourself to people you had never met before came with its own hesitation and awkwardness. 😅
 
After an overview of ICAI, we were given a team activity: prepare and perform a drama.

Our team chose 𝗟𝗶𝗳𝗲 𝗼𝗳 𝗮 𝗖𝗔 𝗦𝘁𝘂𝗱𝗲𝗻𝘁, showing different stages of the CA journey. I played the 𝗧𝗲𝗮𝗰𝗵𝗲𝗿, and performing on stage on the very first day was definitely unexpected!

We ended with a rapid-fire round — and correct answers came with KitKat motivation! 😂

𝗗𝗮𝘆 𝟮 | 𝗖𝗔 𝗦𝗵𝘂𝗯𝗵𝗮𝗺 𝗔𝗴𝗮𝗿𝘄𝗮𝗹
Day 2 brought a completely different energy.

With humour, conversations and shayaris, CA Shubham Agarwal helped us break the ice. Soon, the room felt more like a classroom than a gathering of strangers.

We were divided into groups and given presentation topics. Our group got 𝗔𝘁𝗺𝗮𝗻𝗶𝗿𝗯𝗵𝗮𝗿 𝗕𝗵𝗮𝗿𝗮𝘁. We covered its five pillars, progress, gaps and the way forward. My part was the 𝗘𝗰𝗼𝗻𝗼𝗺𝗶𝗰 𝗣𝗶𝗹𝗹𝗮𝗿, followed by some thought-provoking cross-questions.

𝗗𝗮𝘆 𝟯 | 𝗦𝗵𝗲𝗸𝗵𝗮𝗿 𝗞𝗮𝘂𝘀𝗵𝗶𝗸
Day 3 took us in a completely different direction — 𝗣𝘀𝘆𝗰𝗵𝗼𝗹𝗼𝗴𝘆.

It was an interactive session with relatable examples, humour, childhood memories and discussions around the conscious and subconscious mind.

Then came 𝟭𝟬 𝗾𝘂𝗲𝘀𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻𝘀 𝗱𝗲𝘀𝗶𝗴𝗻𝗲𝗱 𝘁𝗼 𝗺𝗮𝗸𝗲 𝘂𝘀 𝗼𝗯𝘀𝗲𝗿𝘃𝗲 𝗵𝗼𝘄 𝘄𝗲 𝘁𝗵𝗶𝗻𝗸.

One question was:
“𝗦𝗼𝗺𝗲 𝗺𝗼𝗻𝘁𝗵𝘀 𝗵𝗮𝘃𝗲 𝟯𝟭 𝗱𝗮𝘆𝘀, 𝘀𝗼𝗺𝗲 𝗵𝗮𝘃𝗲 𝟯𝟬 𝗱𝗮𝘆𝘀. 𝗛𝗼𝘄 𝗺𝗮𝗻𝘆 𝗺𝗼𝗻𝘁𝗵𝘀 𝗵𝗮𝘃𝗲 𝟮𝟴 𝗱𝗮𝘆𝘀?” 🤔

Most of us immediately answered “𝗙𝗲𝗯𝗿𝘂𝗮𝗿𝘆.”

Our familiar association of 𝟮𝟴 𝗱𝗮𝘆𝘀 𝘄𝗶𝘁𝗵 𝗙𝗲𝗯𝗿𝘂𝗮𝗿𝘆 came to mind before we paused and read the question carefully.
A simple reminder that 𝘀𝗼𝗺𝗲𝘁𝗶𝗺𝗲𝘀 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝗳𝗶𝗿𝘀𝘁 𝘀𝘁𝗲𝗽 𝘁𝗼𝘄𝗮𝗿𝗱𝘀 𝗳𝗶𝗻𝗱𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝗮𝗻 𝗮𝗻𝘀𝘄𝗲𝗿 𝗶𝘀 𝘀𝗶𝗺𝗽𝗹𝘆 𝗽𝗮𝘂𝘀𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝗮𝗻𝗱 𝗹𝗼𝗼𝗸𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝗮𝗴𝗮𝗶𝗻.

𝗧𝗵𝗿𝗲𝗲 𝗱𝗮𝘆𝘀.
𝗧𝗵𝗿𝗲𝗲 𝗱𝗶𝗳𝗳𝗲𝗿𝗲𝗻𝘁 𝗳𝗮𝗰𝘂𝗹𝘁𝗶𝗲𝘀.
𝗧𝗵𝗿𝗲𝗲 𝗰𝗼𝗺𝗽𝗹𝗲𝘁𝗲𝗹𝘆 𝗱𝗶𝗳𝗳𝗲𝗿𝗲𝗻𝘁 𝗹𝗲𝗮𝗿𝗻𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝗲𝘅𝗽𝗲𝗿𝗶𝗲𝗻𝗰𝗲𝘀.

And if these were just the first three days, I’m genuinely looking forward to the 𝗿𝗲𝗺𝗮𝗶𝗻𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝟭𝟮 𝗱𝗮𝘆𝘀. 🌱

𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝘄𝗼𝘂𝗹𝗱 𝘆𝗼𝘂𝗿 𝗳𝗶𝗿𝘀𝘁 𝗮𝗻𝘀𝘄𝗲𝗿 𝗯𝗲 𝘁𝗼 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝗗𝗮𝘆 𝟯 𝗾𝘂𝗲𝘀𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻? 👀

The Institute of Chartered Accountants of India 
The ICAI Gurugram Branch (NIRC) 
Bharat Bhushan 
CA Shubham Agarwal 
Shekhar Kaushik
